description: Worker (playhq-worker/src/index.ts): stamp season_id onto swept appearances, upsert a playhq_sweep_log row per sweep batch with the current distinct player_count for that season, and add a public GET /api/sweep-log read endpoint. Independent of FEAT-002 at the code level, but MUST come first because it defines the /api/sweep-log response contract that FEAT-002 consumes. Touches only the SWEEP path — the REST/backfill/live/passive ingest paths stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Do NOT emit DDL/migrations; the schema is already applied.
steps: A1 — ingestPlayers (playhq-worker/src/index.ts ~line 2348): add an optional param so the signature is `ingestPlayers(summary, env, seasonId?: string)`. After `playersFromSummary(summary)`, build the appearance rows with season_id only when seasonId is defined: `const appearanceRows = seasonId ? appearances.map((a) => ({ ...a, season_id: seasonId })) : appearances;` and upsert `appearanceRows` via the existing `sbUpsert(env, "playhq_player_appearances?on_conflict=player_id,game_id", appearanceRows)` call. Leave the players upsert unchanged (no season_id on players).

A1 — runSweepBatch (~line 2450): add trailing optional param so the signature is `runSweepBatch(gradeShortId, offset, limit, env, seasonId?: string)`, and change the per-game ingest call to `await ingestPlayers(summary, env, seasonId)`.

A1 — sweep-competition handler (~line 2837): change the call to `const batch = await runSweepBatch(gradeId, offset, limit, env, resolved.season.id);`. Do NOT alter runBackfillBatch (~2397/2418), the live/team-list `ctx.waitUntil(ingestPlayers(summary, env))` calls (~3158/3220), or any REST function.

A2 — add helper `async function updateSweepLog(env: Env, resolved: SeasonGrades, seasonId: string): Promise<void>` near the sweep functions. Body wrapped in try/catch (swallow + `console.warn("updateSweepLog failed:", ...)` like ingestPlayers): read distinct ids with `const rows = await sbGet(env, \`playhq_player_appearances?select=player_id&season_id=eq.${encodeURIComponent(seasonId)}&limit=50000\`);` then count unique via `const count = new Set((rows as Array<{ player_id?: unknown }>).map((r) => String(r.player_id))).size;` then `await sbUpsert(env, "playhq_sweep_log?on_conflict=season_id", [{ season_id: seasonId, competition_name: resolved.competition.name, organisation_name: resolved.organisation.name, player_count: count, last_swept_at: new Date().toISOString() }]);`. Rely on sbGet/sbUpsert env-guards (they no-op when Supabase env is unset).

A2 — call the helper in the sweep handler once per batch on the normal path: after `const batch = await runSweepBatch(...)` and before building the JSON response, add `await updateSweepLog(env, resolved, resolved.season.id);`. It must never throw into the handler (best-effort) and must not change the response shape.

A3 — add public read endpoint in the GET routing section (after the gradesMatch block ~line 3078, before the careerMatch block): `if (url.pathname === "/api/sweep-log") { try { const rows = await sbGet(env, "playhq_sweep_log?select=season_id,competition_name,organisation_name,player_count,last_swept_at&order=last_swept_at.desc"); return json(rows, 200, { "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=15", ...cors }); } catch { return json({ error: "sweep_log_failed" }, 502, cors); } }`. No token gate. Uses the same json()/cors helpers as the grades endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: ingestPlayers has an optional seasonId param; when passed, every appearance row upserted carries season_id = that season; players rows are unchanged.
Only the sweep path passes seasonId — runBackfillBatch, the live/team-list ctx.waitUntil ingest calls, and all REST functions are unchanged (no season_id added to those bodies).

After each sweep batch a single playhq_sweep_log row is upserted (on_conflict=season_id) with competition_name/organisation_name from the handler's resolved result, player_count = count of distinct player_id in playhq_player_appearances where season_id = this season, and last_swept_at = now ISO; failures are swallowed and never abort the batch.
GET /api/sweep-log returns all playhq_sweep_log rows (season_id, competition_name, organisation_name, player_count, last_swept_at) ordered by last_swept_at desc, with no token required.
The BACKFILL_TOKEN gate on the sweep endpoint, the limit cap (12), the resumable cursor contract, and retryable/throttled fields are all unchanged; no new env vars introduced.

Re-read the diff to confirm runBackfillBatch, the ctx.waitUntil(ingestPlayers(...)) calls, sbInsert, and the sweep endpoint's token/limit/cursor/throttle logic are unchanged.
findings:
DONE. `cd playhq-worker && npm install && npx tsc --noEmit` passes with no type errors. Changes are confined to the sweep path in playhq-worker/src/index.ts; runBackfillBatch, the live/team-list ctx.waitUntil(ingestPlayers(summary, env)) calls, sbInsert, all REST functions, the BACKFILL_TOKEN gate, the limit cap (12), and the cursor/throttle contract are byte-for-byte unchanged. No DDL/migrations emitted; no env vars added.

/api/sweep-log RESPONSE CONTRACT for FEAT-002 mapping: on success returns HTTP 200 with a JSON ARRAY (not an object) of playhq_sweep_log rows ordered by last_swept_at DESC. Each row has EXACTLY these fields (selected order), with types as stored by Supabase/PostgREST:
  - season_id: string (short PlayHQ season id, e.g. "ce93ea21")
  - competition_name: string | null (from resolved.competition.name)
  - organisation_name: string | null (from resolved.organisation.name)
  - player_count: number (JS-counted distinct player_id in playhq_player_appearances where season_id = this season; integer)
  - last_swept_at: string (ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. new Date().toISOString())
Response header: Cache-Control: public, max-age=15 (plus CORS). No token/auth required.
Error case: HTTP 502 with body { "error": "sweep_log_failed" } if the Supabase read throws. NOTE: when Supabase env is unset, sbGet returns [] (env-guarded), so the endpoint yields an empty array 200, not an error.

SWEEP SIDE EFFECTS (for context): ingestPlayers now accepts an optional seasonId; only the sweep path passes it (resolved.season.id), stamping season_id onto playhq_player_appearances rows. updateSweepLog(env, resolved, seasonId) is called once per sweep batch (best-effort, swallowed) and upserts the single playhq_sweep_log row on_conflict=season_id.
